full_details: You did not pack the bags again. The bay had had eleven days' grass and was no sweeter. On the bridge you left the tables shut. At Shipston you retied her knot and would not have it improved. Long Compton was dry, and the stones stood clear. Chipping Norton was noon. You slept early.
one_sentence: Anne stood in the door while the children slept, and at the Bear the spring notes were less good than they had seemed at home.
title: Left Anne in the door and slept at the Bear
